# Aegis US recession monitor

> Aegis US recession monitor, edition of Nov 27, 2026: 1 of 6 lights on: Calm. Roadmap stage: Cracks spread. AI credit crisis, as it happens: 0 of 6 readings at crisis level. Six tested recession warning lights plus a 2027 bear-scenario roadmap, updated each weekday from FRED, Treasury and Cboe data. Research, not investment advice.

Page: https://steveudd-afk.github.io/aegis-recession-monitor/
Feed: https://steveudd-afk.github.io/aegis-recession-monitor/feed.xml
Edition: 2026-11-27

## Recession warning (tested 1976-2026; 3+ lights = Warning)
Status: 1 of 6 lights on: Calm
- Yield curve · Off | 10-year minus 3-month: now 0.69 pt; lowest month in the past year 0.31 | on if below 0 in any of the last 12 months
- Credit · Off | Baa minus 10-year: 1.61 pt, 0.15 above its 12-month low | on if 0.5 above its 12-month low
- Unemployment and job openings · Off | Unemployment 0.00 pt above its 12-month low (real-time Sahm); job openings 0.05 pt below their 12-month high (Sep 2026) | on when both are 0.29 or more (Michaillat and Saez 2024)
- Layoffs · Off | Initial claims 4-week average 196k, 0.4% above its 52-week low | on at 15% above
- Housing · Off | Building permits 3-month average 1366k, -11.3% from its 12-month high | on at 15% below
- Stocks · On | S&P 500 7183 vs 10-month average 7329 | on if below

## Roadmap: 2027 bear scenario (a scenario, not a forecast)
### Late 2026: Stress in the corners [Confirmed]
- met: AI build-out still accelerating (big-tech capex up 50%+ on a year ago) (now: up 118%)
- met: Money stays expensive (10-year 4.5%+, mortgage 6.5%+) (now: 10-year 4.94%, mortgage 7.21%)
- met: AI credit swaps elevated (Oracle 5-year above 200 bp) (now: 356 bp)
- met: Home prices falling after inflation (now: -2.15% a year after inflation)
### Early 2027 (we are here): Cracks spread [Not yet]
- not met: Home prices fall in dollars (Case-Shiller below 0%) (now: 2.1% a year)
- not met: AI stress reaches the bond market (BBB spread above 2.0%) (now: 1.24%)
- not met: Junk-bond spread above 4.0% (now: 3.77%)
- not met: The Fed raises rates again (Fed funds above 3.88%) (now: Fed funds 3.88%)
- not met: Recession warning: 3+ lights (now: 1 of 6)
### Mid 2027: AI building stops as AI credit breaks [Not yet]
- not met: AI credit at crisis level (Oracle swap 600+ bp or CoreWeave 2,500+ bp) (now: Oracle 356 bp, CoreWeave 1,314 bp)
- not met: Big-tech data-center spending shrinking (capex below a year ago) (now: up 118% from a year ago)
- not met: Business investment orders shrinking (now: 1% a month)
- not met: Layoffs: claims 15%+ above their low (now: 0.4% above)
- not met: AI chip rent 10%+ below its high (H100, B200 or B300) (now: H100 $2.89 (5.9% below high), B200 $6.63 (5.6% below high), B300 $7.52 (4.1% below high))
- not met: S&P 500 20%+ below its record (now: 8.1% below)
### Late 2027: Recession [Not yet]
- not met: Recession warning: 4+ lights (now: 1 of 6)
- not met: Payrolls shrinking (now: 112.5k a month)
- not met: Junk-bond spread above 6% (now: 3.77%)
- not met: S&P 500 35%+ below its record (now: 8.1% below)
### 2028: Bottoming [Not yet]
- not met: S&P 500 near normal value (S&P about 3,952) (now: 16% of the way)
- not met: Shiller CAPE at 22 or below (now: CAPE 37.4)
- not tracked: Credit spreads peak and turn down (now: not tracked yet (under test))

## AI credit crisis, as it happens: 0 of 6 readings at crisis level
- Oracle 5-year default swap: 356 bp (Oct 2025: 76 to crisis: 600 bp)
- CoreWeave 5-year default swap: 1,314 bp (calm: 300 to crisis: 2,500 bp)
- NVIDIA 5-year default swap: 147 bp (calm: 30 to crisis: 250 bp)
- AI chip rent below its high (worst of H100, B200, B300): 5.86% (at high: 0 to crisis: 10%)
- AI borrowers under negative rating pressure: 2 of 4 (none: 0 to crisis: 3 of 4)
- BBB bond spread (wider market): 1.24% (calm: 1.0 to crisis: 2%)

Research, not investment advice. Only the six-light warning is tested on history.
